tutorial.message:
Welcome to Square Garden!
Slide a tile to swap it with its neighbor.
Drag any tile up, down, left, or right to make a swap.

Complete both goals to win!
Create lines of 3 RED and 3 BLUE tiles.

Each swap uses one move.
Watch your move counter!

Complete both goals!
4 BLUE and 3 GREEN in a line.
Use fewer moves to earn more stars.

Now handle two goals at once!
Create 4 GREEN and 3 RED in a line.
Tap the hint button if you get stuck!

Welcome to Pro+!
You have unlocked four cosmic worlds beyond Pro.
Meet the VIOLET tile — a new color found only in these worlds.

The X-shape is a diagonal cross of 5 tiles.
Form one of any color to complete the goal.
The Y-shape is a vertical stem with two arms reaching to the top.

5 tiles of one color form the Y.
Look for natural Y patterns on the board.
